method: This curated ledger records named changes already merged into the project, not every Git commit or a claim of historical accuracy. A feature release records software and editorial delivery, not specialist review. No public correction records have yet been documented. Zero correction records does not establish that the archive is error-free.

roles.label: Maintainer and release editor
roles.description: Responsible for approving public updates through GitHub; a release commit does not constitute independent historical review.

roles.label: Subject editor
roles.description: Future role for section-specific historical, manuscript, biblical, linguistic or diaspora editorial decisions.

roles.label: Independent specialist reviewer
roles.description: Requires an identified, qualified person, documented scope, date and assessment before a completion claim may be displayed.

roles.label: Community testimony and rights custodian
roles.description: A future responsible person or institution needed before accepting private interviews, releases or restrictive material.

changes.title: Ancient text and translation comparisons
changes.summary: Seven source-edited Middle Assyrian tablets now show sixteen tiny, attributed sign-sequence excerpts with line references, original editorial English reading cues and uncertainty notes. Two catalogue-only objects remain without invented ancient-language text; an original five-section methods chapter, three new scholarly notation sources and nine queued claims complement the text-comparison reading room.
changes.impact: The source publication, attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 terms are visible. Transliteration snippets are distinguished from normalized Akkadian, scholarly translations and independent sign collation; historical and philological verification remains outstanding for all new claims. No image copies, unauthorized full translations or fictitious readings have been included.

changes.title: Individual tablet and archaeological case files
changes.summary: Nine original accessioned object studies with catalogue and CDLI/edition identity, findspot and dating disclosures, line-scope metadata, eight new curated institutional source references, 36 new mapped research sections, 12 anchored claims and a dedicated public object case-file room.
changes.impact: Eight Middle Assyrian objects and one separately labelled later Babylonian Chronicle are connected to their institutional records. A catalogue match is not an independent translation, complete biography or specialist philological review; all new claims remain unreviewed. Museum images and scholarly text editions have not been copied.

changes.title: Middle Assyrian social history and everyday life
changes.summary: Nine new original research guides with 45 section-specific reading trails, ten specialist institutional and academic source records, fourteen anchored claims awaiting review, a social-history research hub and a provincial timeline entry.
changes.impact: Law codes remain normative rather than proof of universal actual practice. Administrative and archaeological archives describe selectively documented households and institutions. Biblical passages are used as separately dated primary texts for their own accounts, not as Middle Assyrian contemporary administrative records. No independent specialist sign-off, object-level line collation or permissions for third-party imagery is claimed.

changes.title: Historical and biblical evidence dossier expansion
changes.summary: Eight new original Bible-primary historical dossiers with 40 source-mapped sections, six museum and inscription-corpus reference records, twelve text-anchored verification claims and a browseable research hub.
changes.impact: Scripture is primary for statements about the biblical account, while accessioned objects and royal inscriptions are separately labelled historical witnesses. These are curated research routes, not independent specialist approval or a verified line-by-line transcription of ancient documents.

changes.title: Source integrity and accessibility audit
changes.summary: Added structural citation validation for curated source records, bounded monthly/manual external URL checks, a public audit page and machine-readable offline index, automated accessible-markup regression tests, corrected keyboard menu handling and accessible atlas status text.
changes.impact: External URLs have not been certified live by the offline build; monthly HTTP probes require human interpretation. Manual device, contrast, screen-reader, Syriac shaping, subject-expert verification and release indexing reviews remain outstanding.

changes.title: Publication stewardship and preservation integrity
changes.summary: Added full generated-site SHA-256 manifests, strict file-integrity verification, deterministic ZIP export with tested recovery, public stewardship guidance and stronger root, subpath and deployment checks.
changes.impact: Fixity does not prove historical truth or provide an independent offsite backup. Actual custodianship, accessibility review, source link maintenance, independent specialist review and search-indexing approval remain outstanding.

changes.title: Public editorial governance and revision history
changes.summary: Added public corrections and review policy, role disclosures, a curated merged-commit register and blank editorial planning worksheets.
changes.impact: No secure private correction intake, appointed specialist reviewer or confirmed public correction case is claimed. This milestone implements editorial infrastructure, not independent historical adjudication.

changes.title: Community testimony and heritage research
changes.summary: Added the public heritage reference room, six original source-mapped articles and blank private-first planning worksheets.
changes.impact: The catalogue links to externally published records; no new private interview content, audio or release forms were collected.

changes.title: Language and script reference expansion
changes.summary: Added eight source-linked language studies and a Unicode-anchored Syriac letter reference room.
changes.impact: Letter identities are validated; pronunciation and original manuscript images remain externally linked or under future expert review.

changes.title: Historical atlas evidence and uncertainty
changes.summary: Added per-stage reconstruction limits, source-scope notes and routes to historical articles across eleven atlas stages.
changes.impact: Map polygons remained schematic and unchanged, and specialist geographic review remains outstanding.

changes.title: Historical encyclopaedia depth expansion
changes.summary: Added fourteen historical reading guides, original sections and section-level bibliographic trails.
changes.impact: Academic and biblical references were linked, but independent specialist verification and inscription-level comparisons remain outstanding.

correction_policy: A dated public correction record is created only after a specific published problem and editorial action are documented. Pending private reports and sensitive personal information must not be published. Substantive corrections should retain a link to the affected article, the evidence and a dated immutable commit; unresolved issues must not be labelled resolved.

statuses.feature-release: A merged website or content delivery, not specialist validation.
statuses.correction: A publicly documented substantive change to a published error, with its limits and supporting source trail.
statuses.clarification: A publicly documented substantive qualification that does not necessarily assert previous text was false.
statuses.withdrawal: An explicit notice that affected editorial material should no longer be relied on.
